text:
emily.cho: Hey team — need just-in-time kube-admin for prod-models namespace to debug a tail-latency issue on the model-serving pods. Estimated 30m. Ticket INC-4821. I only need to run 
```
kubectl -n prod-models exec -it svc/model-frontend -- /bin/bash
# tcpdump to capture 60s on interface eth0
tcpdump -c 600 -w /tmp/trace.pcap
# inspect kv cache metadata via /opt/bin/kv-inspect --pod model-frontend
```
Will not pull application logs with user data; only network/kvcache traces. Requesting approval and any redaction/recording requirements.

ajay.patel: Can you explain why kube-admin is required vs a RoleBinding for a specific verb on the pod? Also what exact TTL do you want?

emily.cho: Good q. Need exec + tcpdump + ability to read /proc/net and /var/run/kvcache.sock — we tried a limited RoleBinding but kv-inspect needs access to hostNetwork namespaces for the capture. TTL 30m is fine. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-latency-debug

priya.rao: Please add the INC-4821 link in the request (so ops can tie audit). Also include a note confirming you won't copy any plaintext user payloads out of the pod. Once that's there, sec-bot can kick off ephemeral creds.

sec-bot: Ephemeral access request received for emily.cho (INC-4821). Policy reminder: max 24h, default 30m. Audit logging and session recording will be enabled. Required fields missing: confirmation of no PII copies. Reply with "consent: no-PII-copy" to proceed.

leo.grant: +1 on 30m, approve provided sec-bot requirements are met and session will be recorded. Please ensure session ID is posted here after start. :lock: :mag:

emily.cho: consent: no-PII-copy. Will run under session-recording (recording=true) and will redact any identifiers before uploading. Starting once creds are provisioned — will paste session id. Thanks.

nina.kim: Quick reminder: run the redact helper after capture: `scripts/redact-pcap.sh /tmp/trace.pcap` before storing. If you need temporary s3 write, include storage path in INC-4821. Also tag the audit with `reason:model-trace-debug`. Ping me if you hit anything that looks like user content.

emily.cho: Got it — will run redact helper and update ticket. Planning start 2265432250, ETA 30m.

sec-bot: Ephemeral credentials issued to emily.cho for prod-models (TTL=30m). Session recording enabled. Audit ID: AUD-2026-09-8742.

emily.cho: Started session (AUD-2026-09-8742). Posting session link: https://sesh.redwood.internal/AUD-2026-09-8742 — will update ticket when finished.

leo.grant: Thanks — approve resolved. Follow up with a short postmortem if you find anything nontrivial.

emily.cho: Will do, thanks all.
